_readme: Directories auto mode treats like the working directory: edits and shell writes
landing inside one skip the screener. Edited here, applied on the next call.
The working directory of the session is always trusted and needs no entry.
Entries must be absolute; '~/...' and '$TMPDIR' are expanded, nothing else is.
Symlinks are resolved before the check, so a link out of a root does not widen it.
Files that look like credentials (auth.json, .env, id_rsa, .ssh/…) are screened
wherever they live — a root does not cover them.
